Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Gilroy for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 21 (the opening night of North Pole Nights at Gilroy Gardens) through December 31, with the Downtown Gilroy Holiday Festival and Parade (December 5), Lunch with Santa at Gilroy Gardens (December 12 and 13) and the Holiday Feast at Gilroy Gardens (December 19 and 20) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Gilroy

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Gilroy
  • 1 free event, the Downtown Gilroy Holiday Festival and Parade
  • Meet Santa: Santa's Village at the Holiday Festival and Parade (December 5), Lunch with Santa at Gilroy Gardens (December 12 and 13) and Santa's Workshop at North Pole Nights
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Holiday Festival and Parade with the downtown tree lighting (December 5)
  • Trains and lights: North Pole Nights at Gilroy Gardens, with Tinsel's Groove Train through the redwoods and a 100-foot tunnel of lights (select dates November 21 to December 31)
  • Family dinner: the Holiday Feast at Gilroy Gardens (December 19 and 20), with kids under 12 eating free
  • Season: November 21 to December 31

Planning a bigger day out? Gilroy families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in San Jose. Hollister is next door too, with the Lights On Celebration Parade and Santa at Bourdet Christmas Trees.
